lines.text: Most people use systems. I break them, to see how they hold together.
I'm Muhammad Haseeb Ashfaq. Online, I'm Kaido.
A Year 13 student in Dubai, where offensive security meets AI.
I started in threat intelligence and pen testing: Burp Suite, Ghidra, Wireshark, Nmap.
Now I'm focused on AI security: prompt injection, jailbreaks, and attacking language models.
I designed WSH '26, our school's hackathon and CTF, with 30+ custom challenges.
I run a Raspberry Pi security homelab, wrote an A* Cambridge research paper, and rank in TryHackMe's top 35%.
And I'm open to internships in AI and offensive security.
